caption: Faraglioni, Capri
composition: Three limestone sea stacks from the water · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Shot from the water at dawn, the three limestone stacks fill the frame — the smaller crag at the left, the great central rock pierced by its natural arch, and the tall rounded mass at the right. The sea is calm and dark blue below them, and the sky behind glows pale pink and grey at 06:56, the sun still below the horizon. The arch through the middle stack is the picture's anchor, a dark oval framing the open sea.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Faraglioni off Capri at predawn
